import re

def parse_ics_file(filepath):
    """Parse an ICS file and return a list of (start, end, summary) tuples."""
    events = []
    with open(filepath, 'r') as f:
        content = f.read()
    
    # Extract all VEVENT blocks
    event_pattern = re.compile(
        r'BEGIN:VEVENT(.*?)END:VEVENT',
        re.DOTALL
    )
    
    for match in event_pattern.finditer(content):
        event_block = match.group(1)
        
        # Extract DTSTART and DTEND
        dtstart_match = re.search(r'DTSTART:(\d{8}T\d{6}Z)', event_block)
        dtend_match = re.search(r'DTEND:(\d{8}T\d{6}Z)', event_block)
        summary_match = re.search(r'SUMMARY:(.+)', event_block)
        
        if dtstart_match and dtend_match:
            dtstart_str = dtstart_match.group(1)
            dtend_str = dtend_match.group(1)
            summary = summary_match.group(1) if summary_match else "No Summary"
            
            # Parse datetime (format: YYYYMMDDTHHMMSSZ)
            dtstart = datetime.strptime(dtstart_str, '%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ')
            dtend = datetime.strptime(dtend_str, '%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ')
            
            events.append((dtstart, dtend, summary))
